entries.en: then; at that time
entries.notes: 汉文第二字有卒/悖之疑，释义主要依西语 entonces 与 M/R 栏音写（hù chŭn / hý chūnⁿ）定夺。

entries.en: then; at that time
season; time; then, at that time

entries.zh: 那时；当时〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: then; at that time (tentative)
entries.notes: H/R 两栏均[空]，M 栏有 hú/fiu 之疑，仅凭西语 entronces 与 M 音（音同第2条「許時」）推断，故列低置信。

entries.en: entrails; bowels, intestines
bosom, inmost feelings; heart (figurative sense of entrañas)

entries.zh: 心肝；心（亦用作爱称，如「我的心肝」）
entries.en: heart; inwards; term of endearment (my darling)
to enter; to go in
entries.notes: 西语词头截作「Entriar-」，M 栏例词后半 laj bahal 未明；义据 H「入」与音写 xip（=ji̍p）定夺。

entries.en: to plunge in, throw oneself (into the water); to enter
entries.notes: 西语修饰语 amojandose utalagua 疑读作 ut al agua（弄湿而入水），投水之义依赖推断。

entries.zh: 涵；水浸入、漫入（如船舷进水）
entries.en: to submerge, soak; (of water) to seep or flood in through the ship's side
entries.notes: 汉字有湏/涵之疑；西语 entrava agua por el bordo del navio 谓水漫入船舷，字义依赖推断。

entries.en: to advance; to go forward, in front
to come in
entries.notes: 第二字有耒/來之疑，音义皆合「入來」（ji̍p-lâi，进来），取「來」。

entries.en: to go in; to enter inside
to shoot into; to pierce in
entries.notes: 西语词头 entray. 释读不明，义据 H「射入」与 M/R 音写（choh xip / ſiē xīp）三栏定夺。

entries.zh: 进教堂礼拜；落礼拜（做礼拜、望弥撒）
entries.en: to enter the church; to attend Mass, worship

entries.zh: 拥入；一拥而进（仓促涌入）
entries.en: to enter in a rush; to burst in all at once
entries.notes: 汉字有妥/安之疑，且 M（bōrj）与 R（vāng）音写不一；de rondón 义为仓促、一下子，释义据西语推断。

entries.en: to be reckoned in; to count within, be included in the account
entries.notes: 西语 urgando 疑为 hurgando（拨算）；M 栏 qŭy 与首字「甲」（或为「合」，kap，合裡算）依赖推断，义为计入。

entries.zh: 上算；一并列算（与众人同计）
entries.en: to be counted along with the rest; to enter the reckoning

entries.zh: 夺去；强占夺出（进入他人之地而夺取）
entries.en: to seize and carry off; to enter another's land and take it by force
entries.notes: H 栏「奪出去」与 M/R 音写（hun chŭr…，音近「分出去」）不尽合，以「奪」字与西语 tomalla（夺取）为准。

entries.en: to enter the enemy kingdom without fighting or subduing it
entries.notes: 汉字失/矢存疑，且音写（fit kŭi）与汉字读音不合，汉文侧语义无法确证，释义以西语词头为准，故列低置信。

entries.en: to lodge overnight; to put up for the night
entries.notes: 西语词头 entrar el agua el navio 与「投宿」不合，疑有脱讹（或指船只入港歇宿）；R 栏 tēn zō 与「投宿」音不甚合。
